 Bruce Ou – Private Market Investing at GroveStreet (EP.347) 
 
 Bruce Ou – Private Market Investing at GroveStreet (EP.347) Oct 30, 2023

 Bruce Ou is the Managing Partner of GroveStreet, a boutique firm
that has invested $10 billion in the private markets on behalf of
fourteen institutional clients. GroveStreet specializes in managers
that transform companies in venture capital, growth equity, and
middle market buyouts.

 

Our conversation canvasses Bruce’s emigration from China, thoughts
on middle market buyouts, venture capital, and growth equity
investing, opportunities in China, and co-investments.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
